Name: Word Archon
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Word archons resemble tall humanoids wearing breastplates, carrying magical warhammers, and with wings behind them that are not made of feathers, but instead are made of sheets of scripture and parchment collectively in the shape of wings. These archons are capable of tapping into Truespeech - the language of the multiverse at the foundation of all communication - allowing them to speak in such a way that any creature can comprehend their words. They cannot be silenced, and they can use their Truespeech to perform utterances, invoking words of power to call upon various magical effects.

In Somnus Domina these archons serve many of the more academic Eidolons, particularly favoring Vestias, Marrias and So’kess. In particular, word archons are the keepers and guides of the demi-plane in Mechanus, Vulta de Congenio, where they aid the Correfonts in keeping their records and enforcing the laws that So’kess and Vestias expect the Correfonts to adhere to. Though lawful good by nature, they are willing to serve more morally ambiguous gods if they uphold the concepts of knowledge and truth.

**WORD ARCHON**
*Medium celestial (archon), lawful good*
**Armor Class** 16 (breastplate)
**Hit Points** 130 (20d8 + 40)
**Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (hover), teleport 30 ft.
**Quality Traits** Anchored, magic resist
**STR** 16 (+3) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 15 (+2) | **INT** 24 (+7) | **WIS** 13 (+1) | **CHA** 17 (+3)
**Saving Throws** Wis +5, Cha +7
**Skills** Insight +5, Intimidation +7, Perception +5, Persuasion +11
**Resistances** psychic
**Immunities** lightning, poison, radiant; B/S/P (magical)
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
**Senses** truesight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15
**Languages** all, telepathy 120 ft.
**Challenge Rating** 9 (5000 XP) **Prof Bonus** +4

***Aura of Pacification.*** A hostile creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the archon or moves there for the first time on its turn must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is frightened of the archon until the start of their next turn. A creature that succeeds this save is immune to the Aura of Pacification of all archons with a CR of 9 or lower for 24 hours.

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The archon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***At will:*** command, continual flame, protection from evil and good, suggestion
• ***1/Day each:*** compulsion, confusion, hypnotic pattern, mass suggestion

***Truespeech.*** The archon speaks the language of the universe, and so can be understood by all creatures that can hear it, including understanding the archon’s intentions. They cannot be silenced, and can speak in any condition. Even in a space where no sound exists or where it has been magically stifled, their voice can still be heard and carries.

When the archon uses its Divine Utterance or Word of Harm and forces a creature with 50 hit points or fewer to make a saving throw, that creature has disadvantage.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The archon makes three weapon attacks, each of which can be replaced with its Word of Harm if it wishes.

***Runic Warhammer.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d6) radiant damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d6) radiant damage if wielded with two hands.

***Word of Harm.*** The archon speaks a word of harm in Truespeech, forcing one creature within 240 feet of it to make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failure.

***Divine Utterance (Recharge 5-6).*** The archon speaks a word of power in Truespeech, invoking one of the following effects:
• ***Might.*** The next time the archon’s warhammer hits a creature (within the next minute), that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure the hit deals an extra 28 (5d10) force damage, and the creature is knocked back 15 feet and falls prone. If the creature succeeds the save they are knocked prone but take no damage.
• ***Protection.*** The archon gains 33 (5d12) temporary hit points, and magical charms surrounding it grant disadvantage to all ranged attacks made against it for 1 minute, or until it loses those temporary hit points.
• ***Restoration.*** The archon and all creatures it chooses within 15 feet of it regain 17 (3d10) hit points.
• ***Shockwave.*** The utterance unleashes a wave of power. All creatures the archon chooses within 30 feet of them must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 17 (3d10) force damage plus 17 (3d10) psychic damage and are knocked prone on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Stagger.*** The utterance unleashes a wave of power. All creatures the archon chooses within 30 feet of them must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 17 (3d10) force damage plus 17 (3d10) psychic damage and are knocked prone on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a successful one.
